turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What made you consider canceling last month?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We hit our rate limit during a compliance deadline crunch and support took over 24 hours to raise it, which nearly caused us to miss a client deliverable. That was a five-alarm moment for us internally.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Your team proactively reached out with a permanent rate limit increase and a partial credit for the incident. That responsiveness bought back a lot of trust, but we're still cautious.
